ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: harbinger
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Harbingers do not so much fight as announce. Every curse they speak is a promise, and every promise is kept.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Prophet of the end. Lay Omens on your enemies, then break the Seventh Seal and watch it chain through the crowd.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'I saw seven crows on the roof this morning,' said the trader. The Harbinger smiled. 'You will see one more.'
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Build Omens with crows, prophecies and your allies' own gunfire (Fated), then cash them in: Toll the Bell for a single kill, Last Rites for a crowd, or let seven of them break the Seventh Seal, which ignores armour, scales with the victim's own vitality and splashes Omens onto its friends. Wants Focus and Potency.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: doomsayer
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Doomsayers have stopped predicting the end and started scheduling it.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Speak the end aloud. Doom clocks, shared fates, words that unmake, and the Apocalypse itself.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: She published the date. Most people did not take it seriously, which is how she knew it was right.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: The purest Omen engine. Words of Unmaking spreads Omens down a chain, Shared Fate links a crowd so one Seventh Seal hurts them all, and Final Hour deletes a single target. The Apocalypse puts three Omens on everything on the map. Wants Focus and Attunement.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: pale rider
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: The fourth horseman, or someone who borrowed his horse. Pale Riders fight up close and grow stronger with every death.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Behold, a pale horse. Reap with a scythe of pale fire, ride through the enemy line, and harvest their souls.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'And his name that sat on him was Death.' Her name is actually Marta, but the horse is very convincing.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: A front-line reaper. Kills store Souls (more power and speed); Soul Harvest spends them in a huge nova. Reap executes the weak, Ride Them Down tramples a path through a line, and Death Rides blinks you from enemy to enemy. Wants Potency and Resilience.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: cataclysm
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Some Harbingers announce the end. Cataclysms bring it, one disaster at a time.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: The end of days, on demand. Earthquakes, the bitter star Wormwood, plagues of locusts and the Seven Seals.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: She keeps a list of disasters on her wall and crosses them off. The list is getting short.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Huge, slow, map-shaking area damage that also wrecks buildings and turrets. Split the Earth flings a line of enemies into the air, Wormwood poisons the ground, the Blood Moon lays Omens on everything on the map, and the Seven Seals unfold seven different calamities over one spot. Wants Potency and Attunement.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: bad tidings
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Doom spells sometimes lay an extra Omen.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: unkindness
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Two more crows per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: harbinger of ruin
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: When a Seventh Seal breaks, a crow of ill omen flies at the nearest enemy.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: carrion feast
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The crows bring you a share of every death.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: bearer of the seal
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Everything you foretell lands harder, the Seventh Seal included.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: prophet of the end
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every death you cause is foretold. Kills often prophesy the ruin of the nearest enemy for free, and your doom hits harder.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: end times
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Omens fall like rain. Half your Doom hits lay an extra Omen, and every Doom spell costs a fifth less mana.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: herald of the seventh seal
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Death announces you. Anything you kill may burst in a wave of doom that ignores armour.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: babel
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The word leaps to one more enemy per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: certainty
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every doom you speak makes you surer of the next. Casting Doom spells builds Certainty: more power and more criticals.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: prophetic shield
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You saw that blow coming.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: echoing doom
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your prophecies sometimes repeat themselves for free.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: fate's favor
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Fate itself turns some blows aside, at a cost in mana.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: voice of the end
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every word is final. Final Hour and Words of Unmaking recharge far faster and all your doom hits harder.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: unwritten
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your own fate is unwritten. Once a day, when you would die, you rise again in a wave of doom. Cheat Fate recharges twice as fast.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: toll of souls
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every death you cause adds a harvested soul: more spell power and speed, until you spend them.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: reaper's due
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Doom spells finish off enemies left at low health.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: soul glutton
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Each soul feeds you mana and life.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: no rest
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Kills hurry your cooldowns along.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: horseman of death
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You never dismount. Spectral Steed lasts twice as long and returns twice as often, and Ride Them Down hits harder and recharges fast.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: grim reaper
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every swing is a harvest. Reap recharges twice as fast and anything you hit below 15% health dies.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: siege of heaven
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your calamities often collapse energy shields outright.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: world breaker
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Machines break as easily as men when the world itself is against them.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: rain of fire
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Four more strikes per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: armageddon
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Everything you call down is bigger. Much bigger.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: extinction
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every death is a small apocalypse: kills often explode in doom, and your calamities recharge faster.

AbilityDef.label: ill omen
AbilityDef.description: Send a crow of ill omen. Its beak deals doom damage that ignores armour and lays an Omen. Seven Omens break the Seventh Seal.

AbilityDef.label: murder of crows
AbilityDef.description: Release six crows that wheel through the air and fall on the nearest enemies, each one laying an Omen.

li.flavor: A gathering of crows is called a murder for a reason.

AbilityDef.label: toll the bell
AbilityDef.description: A single, terrible note for a single enemy: doom damage, plus 35% for every Omen it carries. The Omens are spent.

li.flavor: Ask not for whom it tolls.

AbilityDef.label: prophecy of ruin
AbilityDef.description: Foretell an enemy's death and lay two Omens. If it dies within thirty seconds you regain a quarter of your mana, your other spells cool down by a third, and its doom spreads: three Omens on every enemy within six cells.

AbilityDef.label: sentence
AbilityDef.description: Pass sentence on an enemy. In ten seconds, half of every wound it took in the meantime is dealt again, plus 3% of its vitality for each Omen it carries.

li.flavor: The court of last things is now in session.

AbilityDef.label: fated
AbilityDef.description: Tie an enemy's fate to its wounds for twenty seconds: every time anything hurts it, it gains an Omen. Your allies' gunfire becomes prophecy.

AbilityDef.label: apocalyptic vision
AbilityDef.description: Show everyone in front of you how the world ends. Enemies in a wide cone flee in terror for six seconds and gain two Omens.

AbilityDef.label: black sun
AbilityDef.description: Put out the sun over an area for fifteen seconds. Enemies beneath it can barely see and gain an Omen every two seconds.

AbilityDef.label: doomsday clock
AbilityDef.description: A spectral clock appears over an area and strikes midnight three seconds later: everything beneath takes heavy doom damage, +15% per Omen, and gains another.

AbilityDef.label: last rites
AbilityDef.description: Read the last rites over everyone around you. Every enemy within six cells takes doom damage, +30% per Omen (spent), and you are healed for a quarter of the damage.

AbilityDef.label: memento mori
AbilityDef.description: Whisper to a colonist the exact day of their death. Unsettled and inspired, they throw themselves into their work.

li.flavor: It is not today. Get back to work.

AbilityDef.label: words of unmaking
AbilityDef.description: Speak a word that should not be spoken. It leaps between six enemies, searing each one and laying two Omens.

AbilityDef.label: final hour
AbilityDef.description: Hang a doom clock over one enemy. When it strikes four seconds later the enemy takes massive doom damage, +20% per Omen (spent), plus 8% of its vitality. Nothing outruns its final hour.

AbilityDef.label: shared fate
AbilityDef.description: Bind every enemy in an area to one fate for fifteen seconds: half of any wound one of them takes is dealt to all the others. One Seventh Seal becomes a massacre.

AbilityDef.label: doom spiral
AbilityDef.description: Stare into an enemy's soul and unravel it: a beam that searing doom along its length and lays an Omen every half second for four seconds.

AbilityDef.label: cheat fate
AbilityDef.description: Rewrite an ally's fate. For the next minute, if they would die, they rise again instead.

AbilityDef.label: apocalypse
AbilityDef.description: Announce the end of the world. Every enemy on the map takes doom damage and gains three Omens; three seconds later the sky answers, and every Omen on the map is tolled at once for 35% extra damage each.

AbilityDef.label: reap
AbilityDef.description: Swing a scythe of pale fire in a wide arc. Executes enemies below 20% health and deals triple damage to anything downed or stunned.

li.flavor: Every harvest begins with a swing.

AbilityDef.label: spectral steed
AbilityDef.description: Mount a spectral pale horse for thirty seconds: much faster, harder to stop, and slightly harder to hurt.

AbilityDef.label: ride them down
AbilityDef.description: Ride through the enemy line to the target point, trampling everything in your path for doom damage and knocking it aside.

AbilityDef.label: soul harvest
AbilityDef.description: Spend every harvested soul in one blast of pale fire around you: +15% power per soul (up to +150%), healing you for a fifth of the damage. Some survivors flee in terror.

AbilityDef.label: deathly pallor
AbilityDef.description: Wear death like a cloak for twenty seconds. Enemies near you are slowed by the chill of the grave and gain an Omen every two seconds.

AbilityDef.label: death rides
AbilityDef.description: Become Death for thirty seconds and ride through the battlefield: blink between up to ten enemies, reaping each one for massive doom damage. Anything below 30% health dies outright. Spends your souls for extra power.

AbilityDef.label: split the earth
AbilityDef.description: Split the earth in a line. The ground erupts beneath everything in the way, flinging enemies into the air and cracking walls and turrets.

AbilityDef.label: locust swarm
AbilityDef.description: A plague of locusts descends on an area for fifteen seconds, devouring enemies, stripping their armour and sometimes laying Omens.

AbilityDef.label: wormwood
AbilityDef.description: Call down Wormwood, the bitter star. It smashes into an area and poisons the ground for twenty seconds.

AbilityDef.label: hailfire
AbilityDef.description: Hail and fire mixed with blood rain down on an area: a dozen strikes, each one burning and sometimes laying an Omen.

AbilityDef.label: blood moon
AbilityDef.description: Turn the moon to blood for thirty seconds. Every enemy on the map gains an Omen every five seconds.

AbilityDef.label: the seven seals
AbilityDef.description: Break the seven seals over an area, one after another: conquest, war, famine, death, the martyrs' vengeance, the great quake and the final silence. Each seal is a different calamity.

HediffDef.label: omen
HediffDef.description: A portent of doom hangs over this creature. Each Omen makes it a little more vulnerable; at seven, the Seventh Seal breaks: damage that ignores armour and scales with the victim's own vitality, and the Omens scatter to everyone nearby.

HediffDef.label: prophesied ruin
HediffDef.description: Its death has been foretold. If it dies while the prophecy stands, the Harbinger is rewarded and its Omens fly to its friends.

HediffDef.label: sentenced
HediffDef.description: Sentence has been passed. When it is carried out, every wound taken since is dealt again in part, and each Omen adds to the toll.

HediffDef.label: fated
HediffDef.description: This creature's fate is bound to its wounds: whenever anything hurts it, it gains an Omen.

HediffDef.label: terror
HediffDef.description: It has seen how the world ends and can think of nothing but running.

HediffDef.label: eclipsed
HediffDef.description: Beneath the black sun nothing can be seen clearly.

HediffDef.label: shared fate
HediffDef.description: Bound to the same fate as its companions: part of every wound any of them takes is dealt to all the others.

HediffDef.label: fate rewritten
HediffDef.description: The Doomsayer has rewritten this person's fate. If they die, they will rise again.

HediffDef.label: certainty
HediffDef.description: Every prophecy fulfilled makes the next one more certain. Stacks.

HediffDef.label: harvested souls
HediffDef.description: Souls reaped by the Pale Rider, waiting to be spent. Each one sharpens the scythe.

HediffDef.label: grave chill
HediffDef.description: The cold of the grave slows every step.

HediffDef.label: pale steed
HediffDef.description: Riding a spectral pale horse: faster than the living, harder to stop.

HediffDef.label: death incarnate
HediffDef.description: Death itself rides in this body: nearly untouchable, terribly strong.

HediffDef.label: blood moon
HediffDef.description: The moon has turned to blood: an Omen falls on this creature every few seconds.

HediffDef.label: wormwood
HediffDef.description: The waters have turned bitter: a slow poison from the fallen star.
